summary: D.R. Horton, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to its mortgage repurchase facility. DHI Mortgage, a wholly-owned subsidiary, amended the Fourth Amended and Restated Master Repurchase Agreement, increasing the maximum aggregate commitment to $1.925 billion and extending the maturity to May 4, 2029. The amendment modifies pricing, fees, and financial covenants. Amounts outstanding are not guaranteed by D.R. Horton or its homebuilding/rental subsidiaries. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event. No deal terms apply.
